description: This is a wall-mounted shelf designed in the shape of a sunflower. The central part is a dark brown circular housing with several staggered, dark gray shelves, supported by thin black vertical rods. Surrounding the central unit are eight bright yellow, petal-shaped elements that mimic the appearance of sunflower petals. The overall design is whimsical and decorative, making it suitable for adding a playful touch to a room while also providing storage space.
